message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25 000–30 000 total casualties**.  Estimates usually break this down as:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Belgian forces (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~20 000 |

These figures include killed, wounded, and missing soldiers. Exact numbers vary by source, but the consensus places the total around 25 000–30 000.
